description: Wallet statement for an x402 buyer wallet on Base: every USDC payment checked against the payee's listed Bazaar price (above listed, oversize 10x or more, unlisted), spend and calls per seller, duplicate payments within a minute, payments made after a seller's listing vanished or its pay-to changed, sellers whose certification failed since, whether the wallet itself looks sweep-like, and a CSV of every payment. Use when an agent or its operator needs to account for an x402 wallet's spending. Price: $1.00 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Or send a Skyfire pay or kya-pay token in the kyapay-token header (or in this tool's kyapay-token argument), and this tool charges $1.00 to it. Failed calls aren't charged.

kyapay-token.description: A Skyfire pay or kya-pay token made for Agoranome's service, from a client that can't set the kyapay-token header. Leave it out when paying with x402 or the header.
